_comment: Computed by frontend/scripts/gen_preview_assets.py:gen_nearfield_pair() from the FM/SPH depth and velocity grids for near-field section NF-1. Every number here is transcribed verbatim into flood_query_response.teesta.sph_direct.json and compare.teesta.json -- do not hand-edit this file; re-run the script instead. arrival_s is a travel-time PROXY (section_length_m / mean wet-cell velocity), not the contract arrival definition (first time depth > 0.1 m, m5_specs.md SS4) -- a static max-depth grid has no time axis to measure that from. arrival_diff_s is SPH minus FM: negative means SPH arrives sooner.
